Recommended for – Those seeking a plug n’ play fuzz! A fuzz, a drive, a booster, one knob! Yes, the Golden Ratio is one of the most incredible and practical pedals of today. The idea here is to offer a fuzz that is as plug n’ play as possible, simple and direct. With just one knob, this pedal takes you from a more moderate booster to complete, dirty, and aggressive madness. The source of inspiration for this circuit with only one transistor and selected diodes comes from the extremely rare ALAN YEE FUZZY NUTS, which gained prominence with the great master Nels Cline of Wilco. After some modifications, we achieved the result we wanted! The Golden Ratio is even more amazing for those who like to use the knobs on their guitar to enhance their tone. If you lower the volume, you will have that delicious vintage fuzzy texture. If you leave everything at maximum, your tone will be a sonic blast, an aggressive fuzz! Another advantage is the size of the Golden Ratio, small and easy to fit on the pedalboard. If you enjoy practicality and fuzz, there is no better option than the Golden Ratio. If you like to adjust the knobs on your guitar as an extension of the pedal’s controls, the Golden Ratio is perfect! - **Archive parent:** P008 Golden Ratio
- **Builder:** Collateral FX
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Catalog identity:** P008 Golden Ratio Fuzz
- **Identity:** Collateral FX Golden Ratio, a one-knob fuzz/drive based on the Alan Yee Fuzzy Nuts.

Collateral FX states that Golden Ratio uses a one-transistor circuit with selected diodes and takes its starting point from the rare Alan Yee Fuzzy Nuts, followed by Collateral FX modifications. [1]

No complete factory colorway sequence was established.

- One control.
- One-transistor fuzz architecture.
- Selected diodes.
- 9V operation.
- Guitar and bass compatibility.
- 11 x 6 x 4 cm enclosure. [1]

No formal numbered production revision history was established.

The manufacturer specifies **one transistor** but does not publish its part number. [1]

The manufacturer specifies **selected diodes** but does not publish their part numbers. [1]

The single control moves from a moderate boost through aggressive fuzz. Lower guitar-volume settings produce a more vintage fuzzy texture according to the manufacturer. [1]

1. Collateral FX - P008 Golden Ratio: https://collateralfx.com/en/pedals/p008-golden-ratio/
